title: Solve and Graph Inequalities
objective: I can solve an inequality and graph its solution set on a number line.
model: solve with the inverse operation on both sides (as in equations), then graph the solution set on a number line

widgets.component: which graph represents x > 8, x ≤ 10, x < 5 (verbal descriptions)
widgets.root: Identical to the config warm-up and a legitimate 8-5 review. Keys verified. The verbal-graph format is acceptable here only because it is a warm-up.

widgets.component: solve x + a, x − a, 4x ≥ 14, 48 + s ≥ 75; is x = 5 a solution of x + 4 > 12; which solution and graph description
widgets.root: Keys verified (x > 8, x ≤ 12, x ≥ 15, x < 15, 'No, 9 is not greater than 12', s ≥ 27, x ≥ 3.5, p ≥ 60 closed). Challenge 4.4 correctly traps 'dividing flips the symbol' for a positive divisor. Challenge 2.6's viz shows an open circle at 12 with a ray right, which agrees with the key.

widgets.component: wrong inverse operation, open instead of closed circle, shading follows the step instead of the symbol, dots at whole numbers only
widgets.root: Error step indices match the faulty lines; they target the lesson's solving error and boundary error, and Challenge 4.3 targets the 'graph is only whole numbers' misconception.

widgets.component: solve first then sort x = 10 as a solution; sort by the first step
widgets.root: All six Practice cards and eight Challenge cards checked against their bins.

widgets.component: solve x + a, a smallest/largest whole solution, graph back to inequality, which value is a solution
widgets.root: 6 seeds at L3 and L4: keys right (w − 37 > 36 gives 74; b ÷ 10 > 14 gives 141), graphs agree with their keys (ray from 10 open right gives x > 10). Positive coefficients only, which matches grade 6.

widgets.component: draw the solution on a number line
widgets.root: A manipulable: place the circle, set open or closed, drag the ray. Caveat: at L2 the student draws a given simple inequality and does not solve first; only L4 (Challenge 3.2) starts from x + a or 3x, so the Practice slot does not yet exercise 'solve' in a manipulable.

widgets.component: boundary and least or greatest whole solution, tickets at 4 each, whole numbers 0-10 tested in x − 2 < 5

widgets.root: '$27' and 'she' have no antecedent. The savings story behind 48 + s ≥ 75 is lost, so the item can only be answered by someone who just solved 5.1 and guesses the context.
widgets.replacement: Restate the story in the stem: 'Dani has $48 and needs at least $75, so 48 + s ≥ 75 gives s ≥ 27. Is saving exactly $27 more enough?' and keep the four choices.
